content: Ribahesunuma Hemamohoiena
I ribalau Mose arinai i ene, “Au saema GUIAU arinai, oa eo Arona, Nadabi, eo Abihu, eo Isaraela babadayao tatao‐haiona‐se‐mate‐saudoudoi: eo eda lohaloha eai abo au aihelahui.
Mose iabom abo GUIAU i hanahanaui, na isi taba nige se hanahanaui, tatao hinage taba nige maenayao se saema.

Mose i laoma tatao i heribadi saha eo saha GUIAU i ribaei, eo laugagaeo gamagaridi hinage; abo tatao gamagaridi se heuio arinadi esega, si ene, “Riba gamagaridi GUIAU i ribaedi meta abo ai lauwataidi.”
Arinai Mose GUIAU ena riba gamagaridi i uridi, abo maratomtom ariri eai i enotoro eo aba‐aitalasam i hetoro oea paana eai, du saudoudoi‐labui hinage, Isaraela ana bogao enadi.
Eo Isaraela edi hewahewari i hetamaridi, bena aitalasam gabugabudi, eo labini aitalasamdi, isi ede bulumakau, se heaitalasamdi GUIAU arinai.
Eo Mose osina tupona ie abi ie tore gulewa alodi eai eo osina tupona i lausibusibuei aba’aitalasam potana eai.
Murina eai ribahesunuma bukana ie abi eo i hasiri tatao edi ata’atai eai: to si ene, “Saha eo saha GUIAU i ribaedi meta abo ai ginauriwatai, eo abo ai awa’abiedi.”
Eo Mose osina ie abi i lausibusibuei tatao potadi eai, i ene, “Au ita, ina ribahesunuma osinana ede, ia ede GUIAU i ginauriyao arimiu eai ina riba aridi eai.”
Arinai Mose, Arona, Nadabi, Abihu eo Isaraela edi babadayao tatao‐haiona‐se‐mate‐saudoudoi se sae.
Abo Isaraela edi Eaubada se ita, eo aena ubuna eai doha we’u matuna namanamarina, eo hinage i masaraha ariri doha galewa mamohoina.
Nimana hinage nige i lausini Isaraela edi babadayao potadi eai, na Eaubada se ita, eo se ai eo se nom.
Mose Sinai Oea Tupina eai
GUIAU abo i ribalau Mose arinai i ene, “U saema oea tupina eai, eo nei eai u bagibagi: eo we’u lailaidi tabatabadi abo ea lediwa, potadi eai lauhesom eo laugagaeo ea uridi wa, bena u lauheataedi.”
Arinai Mose i torohai maena heaheari Iosua, eo Mose ie sae Eaubada ena oea tupina eai.
I ribalau babadayao aridi eai, hinage i ene, “Ina au bagibagiemai, i lau e ai uioma arimiu eai: au nuatui Arona eo Hura maemiuyao, ena esau ena pilipili saha abo i lau aridi eai.
Arinai Mose ia sae oea tupina eai, eo eada wa arinai oea i buburi heohi.
GUIAU ena namanamari ie ota Sinai oea tupina eai, eo eada wa i buburi asubena haligigi‐esega. Abo asubena hehaligigi‐labuina eai eada wa boeana eai i eogalau Mose arinai.
Na GUIAU ena namanamari ana ao Isaraela tataodi matadi eai doha oeagi ala’alabalebalelemna oea tupina potana eai.
Eo Mose i soralau eada wa boeana eai, eo ie sae oea tupina eai. Mose hinage oea tupina eai wa ie mia asubena tatao‐labui‐se‐mate eo maiona tatao‐labui‐se‐mate.
